_doc: Things worth knowing (session K, wave 45): life lessons woven into NPC scripts (script life_<id> in the zone's dialogue). Learning one sets flag lesson_<id>; see core/life_lessons.gd and the Almanac page.

lessons.title: Spotting a scam text
lessons.takeaway: Urgency, an odd sender, a link: delete, report to 7726

lessons.title: A Deed that's too good
lessons.takeaway: Pressure, cash and a deadline mean walk away

lessons.title: The call from your bank
lessons.takeaway: Hang up. Ring 159 or the number on your card

lessons.title: Gambling and the house
lessons.takeaway: The house edge never sleeps; help is a call away

lessons.title: Budgeting a week
lessons.takeaway: Fixed costs first, then divide what's left by seven

lessons.title: Reading a payslip
lessons.takeaway: Gross, tax, NI, pension: check your tax code

lessons.title: Renting versus buying
lessons.takeaway: Neither is simply cheaper: count deposit, repairs, freedom

lessons.title: Credit scores
lessons.takeaway: Pay on time; check your own report for free

lessons.title: A bad week
lessons.takeaway: Listen, don't fix. Samaritans: 116 123, free, any hour

lessons.title: Grief, gently
lessons.takeaway: Say their name. No timetable. Cruse: 0808 808 1677

lessons.title: Asking for help
lessons.takeaway: Open the post, tell someone early: free debt advice exists

lessons.title: Cooking on a budget
lessons.takeaway: Compare unit prices; batch cook; lentils are brilliant
